description: Puerto Rico's surf breaks as 787daily's surf hub lists them (/water/surf/), from Surfline, surf-forecast.com, the Surf Atlas, the agencies and the law: the break type (reef, point, beach), the wave (left, right), the swell directions a source says work, size, tide, wind, season, the level, hazards, the Tres Palmas reserve and the schools (with their standing). Filter by region (west, northwest, north, san-juan, east, south, or a town such as 'Rincón', 'Isabela'), level, type and swellFrom (a 16-point compass direction, e.g. 'NNW', or a broad swell: north, northwest, northeast, south); breaks naming no swell come back by name in swellNotNamed, breaks no source rates in levelNotGiven. For a break's call today use get_conditions; for the buoys' swell now, water_conditions_now. Never present a level or size as a guarantee; cite the break's url.

level.description: The surfer's level: breaks a source says suit it

region.description: A region (west, northwest, north, san-juan, east, south) or a town, e.g. 'Rincón'

swellFrom.description: Where the swell comes from: a compass point or a broad swell
